name: Donation Caps
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 12 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 100 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. For determining who wins a college, donations are capped at 10 pennies each; any excess still counts towards the budget. The player donating more after the cap receives all its Fellows' votes; ties award none. The player with more total votes wins; equal totals result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
